queries.sql: SELECT `a`.*, `b`.`Comment`, TIMESTAMPDIFF(Day, `a`.`DateCreated`, CURDATE()) Age, `d`.`Fullname` FROM `tblprf` `a` LEFT JOIN (Select Comment,OrderNo from tblreview group by reviewID order by reviewID DESC) b ON `b`.`OrderNo`=`a`.`OrderNo` LEFT JOIN `tblassignment` `c` ON `c`.`prfID`=`a`.`prfID` LEFT JOIN `tblaccount` `d` ON `d`.`accountID`=`c`.`accountID` WHERE `a`.`accountID` = '2' GROUP BY `a`.`OrderNo`

SELECT `a`.*, TIMESTAMPDIFF(Day, `a`.`DatePrepared`, CURDATE()) Age, `b`.`PurchaseType`, `c`.`Fullname` FROM `tblcanvass_form` `a` LEFT JOIN `tblprf` `b` ON `b`.`OrderNo`=`a`.`OrderNo` LEFT JOIN (Select t1.Reference,t2.Fullname from tblcanvass_review t1 LEFT JOIN tblaccount t2 ON t1.accountID=t2.accountID WHERE t2.systemRole="Staff") c ON `c`.`Reference`=`a`.`Reference` WHERE `a`.`accountID` = '2'
